specificity.text: A few simple steps to elevate your content

stages.text: We start with a meeting to better understand your needs and goals. During this meeting, we discuss your ideas, requirements, and preferences. This helps us create a clear vision of the project and identify the key steps needed for its successful implementation.
The script development is divided into two stages:

subtext.text: We create a list of scripts with a brief description of each concept. After this, you can approve or make changes to these concepts. One concept change is allowed per script during this stage.
We provide a detailed description of each script. Up to three revisions are allowed for each script, with the possibility of using unused revisions for other scripts.

stages.text: After the scripts are approved, we have 5 days to produce the videos. During this period, we shoot all the necessary materials according to the approved scripts. Additional equipment or operators, if required, will incur extra costs.

After the editing style is approved, we have 5 days to complete the video editing. We offer three editing style options: from simple to more complex. The most interesting and complex option may require additional payment. Up to three revisions are allowed for each video, with the possibility of transferring unused revisions to other videos.
